semiconductor_relevance: High — TT Vision Technologies provides critical inspection and measurement equipment for semiconductor manufacturing, enhancing production efficiency and quality control.
summary: TT Vision Technologies SDN BHD specializes in automated machine vision solutions for the semiconductor industry, offering high-speed, high-accuracy PC-based vision systems. Their products are designed for various inspection and measurement applications, including film thickness and critical dimension measurement, utilizing advanced techniques such as ellipsometry and X-ray fluorescence.
capabilities: 3-D X-ray systems for wafer and substrate metrology
